task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First stop, try to go north. With that done, head north. With that accomplished, pick up the fondue from the floor of the laundromat. Once that's all handled, you can stop!
description:
You find yourself in a scullery. An ordinary one.



There is an open door leading north. You don't like doors? Why not try going east, that entranceway is unblocked.

thought: I should try to go north first as instructed.
feedback:
You are in a washroom. An usual kind of place.

You see a counter! Unfortunately, there isn't a thing on it. What, you think everything in TextWorld should have stuff on it?

There is an open portal leading north. There is an open door leading south.
